div.head: EGu 3.1
div.ab: ⁊ gyf mæssepreost folc miswissige æt freolse oððe æt fæstene, gylde XXX scill' mid Englum ⁊ mid Denum ðreo healfmarc.
⁊ gif mæssepreost folc miswyssige æt freolse oððe æt fæstene, gylde XXX scill’ mid Englum ⁊ mid Denum þreo healfmarc.
Et si presbiter populum (suum) misdoceat de festo uel de ieiunio, reddat XXX sol. cum Anglis et cum Danis III dimidias marcas.
⁊ gif mæssepreost folc miswyssige æt freolse oððe æt fæstene, gylde XXX scill' mid Englum ⁊ mid Denum þreo healfmarc.
And gif mæssepreost folc miswyssige æt freolse oððe æt fæstene, gylde XXX scillinga mid Englum and mid Denum þreo healfmarc.
If a mass priest misdirects the people with regard to a festival or fast, he shall pay 30 shillings in an English district, and 3 half-marks in a Danish district.
And if a priest misleads the people concerning a holy day or a fast, he must pay thirty shillings among the English or three half-marks among the Danes.
Und wenn ein Pfarrer die Gemeinde missleitet betreffend Feiertag oder Fasten, zahle er 30 Schill. bei den Engländern und bei den Dänen drei Halbmark.
And if a mass-priest misleads the people concerning a feast or a fast, let him pay 30 shillings among the English and three half-marks among the Danes.
